newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia 91-day Treasury bills yield 6.345 pct.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia 91-day Treasury bills yield 6.345 pct.

text.p: Malaysia's central bank said on Thursday it accepted bids at an average yield of 6.345 percent at its auction of 91-day Treasury bills for 80 million ringgit.
At its previous auction for 91-day bills on May 15 for 80 million ringgit, the central bank accepted bids at an average yield of 6.408 percent.
The bids accepted were in a high/low range of 6.368/320.
At its auction of 182-day bills for 100 million ringgit, the bank accepted bids at an average yield of 6.394 percent.
The bids accepted were in the high/low range of 6.425/340.
